issue.title: Two improvements to tf.split's shape function

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body:
1. Don't break if the size corresponding to a -1 is 0.
2. Infer the size corresponding to a -1 if possible.

Fixes #19360.
